jyutping: ziu3 ping4 si4 gam2 joeng2 V

english.note: Use this construction when an action is done in the usual manner, as in dressing or behaving as usual.

examples.english: Even for banquets, I ordinarily dress as usual and do not make a special effort.
examples.traditional: 去飲宴我都照平時咁樣着衫，唔使特登打扮。
